description: Retrieve a nittim audit by its UUID, at any stage: the finished markdown digest (verdict, scores, top findings) plus its report link, or — no error, nothing charged — that it is still running, or why it failed and what happened to the charge. Free. Reading needs the key of the account that owns the audit.

id.description: The UUID of the saved audit, from the /report/{id} URL.

name: get_audit
title: Fetch a Saved Audit
